runtime-contracts.positive_control: valid UTF-8 HTML, internal targets, and external references are classified and accepted
runtime-contracts.negative_control: malformed markup, invalid UTF-8, duplicate attributes, broken targets, and root escapes refuse

property-stateful-tests.positive_control: Hypothesis generates complete unordered page populations and resolvable extensionless targets
property-stateful-tests.negative_control: every generated parent escape refuses before filesystem resolution

real-entrypoint-recovery.positive_control: the shipped scripts/check_site.py entrypoint validates a corrected site
real-entrypoint-recovery.negative_control: an empty population exits two, a product defect exits one, and a corrected retry exits zero

changed-branch-coverage.command: python -m pytest tests/test_changed_branch_gate.py -q && python -m coverage run --branch --source=sitecheck -m pytest tests/test_check_site.py tests/test_correctness_contracts.py tests/test_correctness_properties.py tests/test_correctness_entrypoint.py -q && python -m coverage run --append --branch --source=sitecheck -m sitecheck.core && python -m coverage json -o artifacts/correctness-coverage.json && python scripts/changed_branch_gate.py --base origin/main --adapter coverage-py-json --report artifacts/correctness-coverage.json --include-root sitecheck
changed-branch-coverage.positive_control: coverage.py emits branch outcomes for changed sitecheck product code
changed-branch-coverage.negative_control: the shared adapter refuses missing reports, unmapped changed product files, and uncovered changed outcomes

correctness-semgrep.positive_control: the raw-byte fingerprint followed by text rewrite fixture is detected
correctness-semgrep.negative_control: normalized and byte-preserving near misses remain clean; tool errors and empty scans refuse

targeted-mutation.positive_control: each unmutated site-check control survives before its mutant runs
targeted-mutation.negative_control: builder and independent parser and resolver mutants are caught separately with byte-exact restoration
